title: Area of an Ellipse via Boundary Line Integral
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Compute the area enclosed by the ellipse x = 5 cos(t), y = 2 sin(t) for 0 <= t <= 2*pi using Green's Theorem.

steps.title: Apply Green's Area Formula
steps.explanation: The differential form (1/2)(x dy - y dx) evaluates to the enclosed area.

steps.title: Substitute Parametric Expressions
steps.mathExpression: x \, dy - y \, dx = (5\cos t)(2\cos t \, dt) - (2\sin t)(-5\sin t \, dt) = 10(\cos^2 t + \sin^2 t) \, dt = 10 \, dt
steps.explanation: Substitute x, y, dx, and dy.
